falsifier: A loop whose invariant is spelled inline and whose divide is STILL hoisted into the preheader, or a named-local form whose divide stays in the body. Either shows the spelling is not the discriminant. Reproduce with `fnasm <unit> <fn> <preheader range> --diff` before and after moving the expression across the loop header; no A/B build is needed to falsify the first half.

value: MWCC's loop-invariant motion is decided by WHERE the value is spelled, not by whether it is invariant. An invariant computed into a NAMED LOCAL before the loop and merely divided inside it (`delta = (u8*)p - (u8*)base; while (...) { t = delta / 240; ... }`) is hoisted ENTIRE: the global load, the subtraction, the divisor materialisation and the `divw` all land in the preheader ahead of the loop-entry branch. The same value spelled INLINE inside the loop (`while (...) { t = ((u8*)p - (u8*)base) / 240; ... }`) is hoisted only in its address-arithmetic parts -- the global load and the `subf` go to the preheader, the `li` of the divisor and the `divw` stay in the body and are recomputed every iteration. A partial hoist in the target (preheader `lwz`+`subf`, body `li`+`divw`) is therefore a SOURCE-SHAPE tell for the inline form, not evidence of a compiler-version or LICM-strength difference. Measured on fn_8005E90C: ours emitted `lwz r3,@sItems` / `li r0,240` / `subf` / `divw` / `b ->b4` at @0x48-0x58 against the target's `lwz` / `subf` / `b ->b4` with `li r0,240` and `divw r3,r5,r0` inside the body at @0x54/@0x5c; deleting the named local and inlining the pointer difference closed that cluster and took real 14 -> 12 with fresh fuzzy 96.8667% -> 99.2000%. COST TO BUDGET FOR: deleting the local drops the frame (72 -> 64 here, an 8-byte step, not 4), so pair the edit with the nominal pad under claim.law.dead-nominal-local-area-tracks-declaration-count.20260831.v1 and re-check the slot map. This refutes the framing that such a residual is a systematic 'our LICM hoists what retail's does not' class needing a cross-function census.
